fit_reason: Whole 1941 Chevrolet two-door listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Flat, chalky faded blue paint across the doors, fenders and trunk lid
Surface rust and worn-through patina on the roof, hood and trunk lid
Dull, dirty chrome and stainless trim along the body side spears and grille
Dirt and road grime along the lower doors and rocker area
Dusty, hazy window glass on the side and rear windows
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1941 Chevrolet two-door. A careful wash and a protective wax would clean up the grime along the lower doors and bring some life back to the faded blue paint and the side trim without disturbing the patina. We do pre-sale details that come to you, so the car doesn't need to run. Would you like a quote?
